body.name: Promised-rank obstruction enumerator
body.construction: Given a supplied total order \(\triangleleft_V\) on \(V\), test every \(R\subseteq V^{-}\) with \(|R|\leq3\) by bidirected connectivity and directed reachability in \(G[R\cup\{s\}]\), retain it exactly when it is a hedge residual and no proper subset is one, and order outputs lexicographically using \(\triangleleft_V\).
